title: MOT-UGC-YAPPER-01 — V22 · Toilet cramping B-roll · 1.2×
summary: V22 adds a new generated toilet-cramping shot during “Backed up, uncomfortable, just waiting.” The same woman wears dark teal pajamas and folds forward clutching her abdomen. Existing 1.2× Michelle voice, captions and 4:21.967 runtime are preserved. New GPT Image 2 first frame inspected. Google Omni blocked animation requests; video insert and native edit are unfinished. Completed V21 remains unchanged. The user’s generated-footage request replaces the earlier TikTok-source search for this beat.

beats.script: I was two months into a GLP-1, dropping weight, and still waking up every morning feeling backed up and uncomfortable like nothing had moved.
beats.visual: Bathroom cramp 0–2.583s → couch forehead rub 2.583–3.833s → same car presenter. Different outfits; continuous narration at 1.2×.
beats.emotion: Recognition — identify the weight-loss/discomfort contradiction.
beats.note: toilet-hook: 00:00.000–00:02.583; couch-hook: 00:02.583–00:03.833. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.visual: Selected second hook frame: same mature woman reclined on grey couch, eyes closed, palm rubbing forehead; new powder-blue ribbed top. Tight overhead phone framing.
beats.emotion: Weary frustration — the discomfort follows her into rest.
beats.note: Couch follows bathroom, then returns to car; synchronized at 1.2×.

beats.script: Let me tell you what I finally found out. Because nobody told me about it either.
beats.visual: Hold the same presenter and let the invitation breathe.
beats.emotion: Curiosity — promise the missing explanation.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Because I was dropping weight. The shot was actually working.
beats.visual: Small acknowledging nod; no scale numbers or weight-loss montage.
beats.emotion: Credibility — acknowledge the shot was working.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: But I felt like someone had filled my gut with concrete and forgotten about it. That heavy backed-up pressure that just sat there all day.
beats.visual: Mature woman seated on sofa, leaning forward and holding her abdomen with a restrained wince. Centered720×720 square overlay. Wardrobe: dusty-rose cotton sweatshirt with a simple crew neck and charcoal soft jogger trousers; no overshirt
beats.emotion: Agitation — make the persistent feeling recognizable.
beats.note: cramping: 00:14.194–00:17.528. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I'd eat a few bites at dinner and feel like I'd swallowed a brick. And it didn't matter how little I ate. It just kept building.
beats.visual: Table-level candid view: fork set down beside a meal with only a few bites taken; body turns away. Wardrobe: burnt-rust short-sleeve knit top and dark brown trousers; no overshirt
beats.emotion: Agitation — show why even a small dinner feels difficult.
beats.note: unfinished-dinner: 00:19.583–00:22.083. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: My jeans were getting looser but I was still leaving the dinner table early because of how uncomfortable I felt.
beats.visual: Waist-level detail: mature hand lightly checks extra room at denim waistband; tee stays over abdomen. Wardrobe: solid navy long-sleeve cotton tee with the same blue jeans; preserve the waistband-check action
beats.emotion: Contradiction — clothes improve while comfort does not.
beats.note: loose-jeans: 00:24.806–00:26.472. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I'd stand in the kitchen after meals just waiting for it to pass.
beats.visual: Side/rear kitchen wide: same woman rests both hands on counter and waits, gaze toward window. Wardrobe: mustard-yellow open cardigan over a plain black top and straight black trousers
beats.emotion: Isolation — make waiting after meals tangible.
beats.note: kitchen-wait: 00:29.611–00:32.083. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And I couldn't explain it to anyone without sounding like I was being dramatic.
beats.visual: Same presenter admits she could not explain it.
beats.emotion: Empathy — vulnerability belongs on her face.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And I genuinely thought losing the weight would fix it. That was the thing. I believed if I just got the number down the rest would follow.
beats.visual: Centered square: overhead white digital bathroom scale on warm tile, neutral0.0ready display. Presenter visible around it.
beats.emotion: Open loop — weight loss was the wrong expectation.
beats.note: bathroom-scale: 00:39.389–00:41.750. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: My doctor's advice was to add more fiber. So I did.
beats.visual: Real TikTok close-up: chickpeas and chopped vegetables tossed in glass dish with red utensils. Food fills frame; no burned-in text/watermark.
beats.emotion: Prior solution — establish she followed advice.
beats.note: tiktok-fiber-foods: 00:42.056–00:43.889. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I was mixing fiber powder into my water every morning, eating high-fiber everything, following every piece of advice she gave me.
beats.visual: Overhead domestic action: one hand stirs cloudy water, plain powder container and breakfast bowl nearby. Wardrobe: lavender waffle-textured robe sleeve and cuff visible at the wrist
beats.emotion: Effort — show the morning routine distinctly from the later ingredient image.
beats.note: fiber-stirring: 00:45.444–00:47.944. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And I gave it real time. Weeks. Then a couple of months. And nothing really moved.
beats.visual: Steady presenter, small pauses between Weeks and Then a couple of months.
beats.emotion: Frustration — effort and time without the desired feeling.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I was still waking up every morning feeling like my gut was full of yesterday.
beats.visual: Dim bedroom side angle: same woman sits on bed edge at dawn, quiet tired posture, gaze down. Wardrobe: pale blue cotton matching pajama set with a small white floral print, long-sleeve button-front top and matching loose trousers
beats.emotion: Persistence — the problem starts before breakfast.
beats.note: morning-heavy: 00:56.528–00:59.028. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: So I went to the pharmacy and got MiraLAX.
beats.visual: Real TikTok product close-up: readable MiraLAX front label on a counter beside a glass. Tight crop excludes source text above and below.
beats.emotion: Specific attempted solution — instantly recognize the product she names.
beats.note: miralax-closeup: 01:00.167–01:01.611. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And that felt like a different kind of moment. That felt like admitting something had genuinely gone wrong.
beats.visual: Face carries embarrassment without a staged crying reaction.
beats.emotion: Vulnerability — explain why the purchase mattered.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I was standing in that aisle thinking I shouldn't need this. But I was desperate enough that I didn't care anymore. I just wanted to feel okay.
beats.visual: Same setup, lower intensity; slight pause before I just wanted to feel okay.
beats.emotion: Empathy — land the human need.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: It helped a little. But the moment it wore off I was right back where I started. Backed up, uncomfortable, just waiting. Something was definitely still missing.
beats.visual: Car presenter → new tight three-quarter toilet shot: dark teal pajamas, hunched forward, hands bracing abdomen, eyes squeezed and strained grimace → car presenter.
beats.emotion: Stuck in discomfort after temporary relief: the toilet context and held cramp show what waiting feels like.
beats.note: New generated insert only during “Backed up, uncomfortable, just waiting.” at 01:17.200–01:19.333. Straight cuts, source sound muted, existing captions retained. Google Omni blocked animation requests; video insert and native edit are unfinished. Completed V21 remains unchanged.

beats.script: So I started doing a crazy amount of research on what was actually happening. I must have read thirty different articles. Forums, medical breakdowns, all of it.
beats.visual: Overhead evening desk: laptop with indistinct article layout, handwritten notes, mug and reading glasses; mature hand on trackpad. Wardrobe: charcoal-gray pullover hoodie with soft ribbed cuffs and black lounge pants
beats.emotion: Search — show effort without inventing an authoritative quotation.
beats.note: research: 01:25.889–01:28.389. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And then I came across a gastroenterologist who had written out exactly what GLP-1 medications do to the gut.
beats.visual: Presenter introduces what she read.
beats.emotion: Discovery — bridge from search to explanation.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: He explained it like this.
beats.visual: Small natural reset before the explanation.
beats.emotion: Orientation — invite the viewer into a simple explanation.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Your stomach is basically a muscle. It contracts, churns your food, and pushes everything forward. But GLP-1 medications slow those contractions down.
beats.visual: Single educational stomach cutaway; later motion is gentle wall contraction/churning, not a blocked valve.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — establish the organ and movement once.
beats.note: stomach: 01:36.639–01:39.972. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Think of a river that suddenly slows to a trickle. Everything that was flowing through starts to back up behind it.
beats.visual: Overhead shallow river view: broad upstream pool feeding a narrow gentle trickle, a few floating leaves.
beats.emotion: Understanding — translate slowed flow into the script’s metaphor.
beats.note: river: 01:45.028–01:48.361. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Food backs up. Waste backs up. Gas builds with nowhere to go. And all that pressure is what you're feeling every single day.
beats.visual: Flat gut-lumen schematic: contents and several gas pockets within a soft tube; no full torso or repeated stomach.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — give gas/pressure a separate visual vocabulary.
beats.note: gas-diagram: 01:50.222–01:52.722. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: It wasn't a diet problem. It wasn't something I was doing wrong. It was the gut slowdown.
beats.visual: Return to direct eye contact; slight release on It was the gut slowdown.
beats.emotion: Relief — remove self-blame and close the first loop.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

timelines.label: UPDATED SCRIPT · B25–B32
timelines.source: Exact approved narration · V18 timing divided by 1.2

beats.script: So now I knew what was causing it. But I still had no idea what actually addressed the slowdown itself.
beats.visual: Same presenter, curiosity rather than a sales pivot.
beats.emotion: Second loop — what addresses it?
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: One night I was up late scrolling through a GLP-1 support group on Facebook. And a woman posted about what she'd been taking. She said she'd been backed up for months on Ozempic until she started using three specific ingredients together.
beats.visual: Centered720×720 square crop of the support-group post: Deborah Williams, mature woman profile photo, recreation label and opening experience paragraphs over the presenter.
beats.emotion: Discovery — move from research to the peer account.
beats.note: group-post: 02:09.250–02:12.583. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: First was apigenin from celery juice. She said it's been shown in research to activate the receptors in the gut wall that trigger those muscle contractions. The ones that actually push food through.
beats.visual: Distinct close view of celery stalks and juice; neutral ingredient image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 1 — give an unfamiliar name a concrete anchor; no simulated proof.
beats.note: celery: 02:19.361–02:21.722; apigenin-research: 02:22.056–02:25.722. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.visual: Centered720×720 square crop of the actual research screenshot, title/authors/upper abstract with study-type label, over presenter.
beats.emotion: Research context — let viewers see the supplied source and its actual study scope.
beats.note: Same centered square article screenshot, synchronized at 1.2×.

beats.script: Second was chlorophyllin, a plant compound that's been studied clinically to bind gas-producing compounds before they get a chance to build pressure.
beats.visual: Dark-green ingredient sample with its existing chlorophyllin label, separate from celery.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 2 — visually separate the second ingredient without an efficacy animation.
beats.note: chlorophyllin: 02:28.194–02:30.694. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Third was a soluble prebiotic fiber. But she was specific about the type because the wrong kind can actually make the gas worse, not better.
beats.visual: Small fine powder portion beside mixed water, existing category image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 3 — make the type distinction legible.
beats.note: fiber: 02:35.028–02:37.528. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: She said it was the only thing that had actually moved the needle. She'd been on the shot for a year and said people at her gym kept asking what she was doing differently.
beats.visual: Same presenter recounts the other woman’s experience.
beats.emotion: Peer story — retain the anecdote without creating false proof.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: I almost kept scrolling. I'd tried the celery juice thing back in 2019 and felt absolutely nothing.
beats.visual: Skeptical recollection; slight head tilt on 2019.
beats.emotion: Objection — voice the viewer’s skepticism.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: But she said it doesn't work that way on its own. You need all three together in the right ratio or you're just guessing.
beats.visual: Continue the reply in her own conversational voice.
beats.emotion: Answer — keep the stated distinction clear.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.note: ingredients: 03:01.750–03:04.250. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: It's two gummies before bed with a full glass of water.
beats.visual: Candid bedside palm with exactly two forest-green heart gummies and a full glass of water. Wardrobe: dusty-peach ribbed long-sleeve knit top with its peach cuff visible at the wrist
beats.emotion: Demonstration — make the nightly action immediately understandable.
beats.note: routine: 03:10.333–03:12.278. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And the first week, honestly, nothing. I thought here we go again. But I kept going.
beats.visual: Disappointment followed by a modest decision to persist.
beats.emotion: Expectation — allow uncertainty.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Then around week two I had dinner with my husband and I got through the whole meal without that pressure building. I sat there, ate a normal amount, and just felt fine after.
beats.visual: Warm close dinner-table detail with her relaxed hand and companion’s hand; ordinary meal. Wardrobe: forest-green smooth blouse with a plain matching sleeve and cuff visible at the wrist
beats.emotion: Payoff — a normal dinner is the emotional center.
beats.note: dinner: 03:19.194–03:21.694. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Not fine after I'd walked around the block waiting for it to pass. Just fine. I hadn't felt that in months.
beats.visual: Hold her face; allow Just fine its own small pause.
beats.emotion: Relief — emphasize ordinary comfort, not a dramatic transformation.
beats.note: Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: By week three my mornings felt different. That heavy backed-up feeling when I woke up had started to ease. I wasn't laying there at six in the morning feeling like my gut was full of yesterday anymore.
beats.visual: Morning mirror action: same woman looks at her own reflected eyes and smiles privately. Wardrobe: soft lilac collarless cotton blouse with three-quarter sleeves
beats.emotion: Progress — a new morning action, not reused bed footage.
beats.note: mirror: 03:32.444–03:34.944. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: Around the five or six week mark I realized I hadn't thought about my stomach in days. That was new.
beats.visual: Rear three-quarter action: woman picks up keys and heads outside, gaze toward door. Wardrobe: medium-wash blue denim jacket over a black tee, beige chinos, white shoes; preserve her bag and keys
beats.emotion: Freedom — attention returns to normal life.
beats.note: leaving: 03:42.778–03:44.917. Approved V18 visual and exact words retained. Entire edit plays at 1.2× with pitch correction.

beats.script: And I know the shot gets credit for the weight coming off. But the part that made me feel like a person again was fixing the thing that made every meal something to dread.

beats.emotion: Meaning — explain why she is sharing.

beats.script: Because you can be losing weight on a GLP-1 and still feel awful every single day. And nobody talks about that part. I'm sharing this because nobody told me either.

beats.emotion: Identification — close the opening promise.
